scope: Refresh current open-source DWG/DXF failure reports and map their specific failure boundaries to local traversal, EED, and DXF-string source/test coverage; identify fast implementation-ready controls without treating peer reports as local defects.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research plus local source and test inspection
sources: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 28, printed page 269
localInspection: src/intern/dwgreader.cpp: readDwgBlocks ownership preflight, walkBlockRecordEntities, and readDwgEed
src/intern/dxfwriter.cpp: length-aware ASCII and binary string writes
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing PAR-14/PAR-26, PAR-49/7G.3, PAR-66/7AN, and string-framing owners
method.evidenceRule: Peer issue bodies, issue status, branch commits, release notes, and formal releases are separate evidence grades. Peer reports generate local test questions only. DWG parsing remains governed by ODA; support requires route-specific source identity, owner, output, and acceptance evidence.

evidence.observed: The report describes an iterator that returned NULL both for end-of-list and an unresolved entity reference, truncating following DXF output. The reporter later said the issue was fixed on LibreDWG master and verified aggregate model-space counts for three AC1021 files against ODA. GitHub still displayed the issue as open in the checked milestone.
evidence.localObservation: The production readDwgBlocks path preflights ownership and quarantines the entire BLOCK_RECORD if an entMap handle is missing. The lower walkBlockRecordEntities path warns and continues. The current ownership test exercises only a one-element missing list at the lower seam; it does not exercise valid/missing/valid siblings or the outer preflight transaction.
evidence.disposition: Historical peer failure pattern, not an active current-master peer defect or a local bug. Add generated coverage for both local policies and make incomplete status observable.

evidence.observed: The issue reports a cquote C buffer whose terminator is placed at buffer capacity, allowing allocator residue through strlen, and a latent empty-after-transformation path that could omit a group.
evidence.localObservation: The audited local writer uses length-aware std::string writes. Existing generated control-character tests inspect ASCII rollback, binary physical framing, following records, and destination preservation. No analogous capacity-based C-string path was found in the audited local route.
evidence.disposition: Peer-only mechanism; retain existing text framing checks and do not add allocator perturbation absent an analogous local buffer.

evidence.observed: The open issue reports a CMC index/method conversion problem and invalid truecolor-to-ACI fallback behavior in LibreDWG.
evidence.localObservation: The plan already records generated R2004+ method-discriminated CMC inputs and a local CMC-to-LAYER-to-ASCII/binary-DXF route with group 62/420, readback, off-state, refusal, and retry assertions.
evidence.disposition: No duplicate local test or finding; keep the source method/index and compatibility fallback distinct.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG milestone title leads #1406 and #1426; ODA EED contract
evidence.observed: The milestone titles mention viewport numbering per block rather than per entmode and item-local EED sizing. Full issue bodies were unavailable in this review, so the titles do not establish format rules. ODA v5.4.1 section 28 defines each EED application record as a bit-short data length, application handle, and data items; the length covers data items but excludes the size prefix and application handle.
evidence.localObservation: readDwgEed allocates exactly the declared per-application data span, parses through a bounded sub-buffer, and checks variable- and fixed-width items. No focused generated DWG EED chunk-boundary vector was found in the inspected test sources.
evidence.disposition: Treat the peer titles as discovery leads only. Add a generated two-application valid case and an item-overrun negative with a following object sentinel under existing parser-safety test owners; do not infer an EED maximum or new grammar.
